data.name: Vivaan
data.gender_notes: Vivaan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Full of life; the sun; a ray of light
data.long_meaning: Often derived from the Sanskrit vi, 'apart, fully', + vāna, 'breath, life' — 'full of life'. Its root is Sanskrit vi + vāna. A modern popular Indian given name. Vivaan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Full of life; the sun; a ray of light”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vivaan expresses “Full of life; the sun; a ray of light”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Often derived from the Sanskrit vi, 'apart, fully', + vāna, 'breath, life' — 'full of life'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vivaan total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
